scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/framework/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/compliance/harness/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w packages/framework && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts && playwright test --project integration --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.verify: npm run build -w packages/framework && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm --workspace apps/template run verify && npm --workspace apps/reference run verify && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts tests/skill/example-pages.test.ts
